sql: with o as (select lo.market_ticker t, regexp_replace(lo.strategy,'_closeout$','') s, lo.side os, lo.action oa, f.side fs, f.price fp, coalesce((f.raw_fill_json->>'count_fp')::numeric, f.quantity) q, f.quantity qi, coalesce(f.fee,0) fee from live_orders lo join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id where lo.created_at > now() - interval '75 days' and lo.strategy like '%mmsell%'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, quantity, realized_pnl, raw_json->>'market_result' mr, (raw_json->>'value')::numeric yv from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), m as (select o.t, count(distinct o.s) ntags, sum(o.q) q, sum(o.qi) qi, sum((case when o.oa='buy' then 1 else -1 end) * o.q * ((case when o.os='yes' then p.yv else 100 - p.yv end) - (case when o.fs = o.os then o.fp else 100 - o.fp end)))/100.0 - sum(o.fee) fpnl, max(p.realized_pnl) rp from o join p on p.t = o.t where p.quantity = 0 and p.yv is not null group by o.t) select ntags, count(*) markets, sum(case when abs(fpnl - rp) <= 0.01 then 1 else 0 end) within_1c, round(sum(fpnl)::numeric,4) fill_pnl, round(sum(rp)::numeric,4) pos_pnl, round(max(abs(fpnl - rp))::numeric,4) max_abs_diff, sum(q) contracts_fp, sum(qi) contracts_int_col, sum(case when q <> qi then 1 else 0 end) markets_with_fractional from m group by 1 order by 1
